points.text: Conceptual gap to prior non-prompt AIR not isolated; VAE prior may be incremental
Fairness of encoder pretraining data exposure versus baselines unclear
No end-to-end wall-clock and memory benchmarks supporting claimed attention speedups
Unseen tests limited to two combinations; more OOD degradation types needed
No real-capture datasets to support robustness claims
Experimental setting non-standard; should add PromptIR/Perceive-IR settings
Main framework figure confusing; degradation map inputs unclear
'Which, where, what' framing lacks convincing experimental support
SupCon pretraining uses degradation labels, contradicting no-prompt claim
Ablation in Table 6 does not support 'which, where, what' motivation
No benchmarking on unseen tasks, only unseen mixed degradations
YOLOv12 experiment claimed as contribution but only in supplementary
Citation brackets missing
PromptIR incorrectly described as using manual prompts
Benchmarks mostly synthetic; real-capture data and ISP/compression robustness lacking
Heavy reliance on PSNR/SSIM; no perceptual metrics or user study
Comparisons with task-specialized SOTA per degradation not comprehensive
Encoder overfitting or latent collapse only qualitatively addressed
Degradation maps and mu-fusion lack quantitative localization validation
No high-resolution latency, tiling memory or windowed-attention comparison
Non-standard protocol; established AIR benchmarks with published checkpoints not used
Baseline numbers implausible, suggesting under-trained baselines with unequal training budgets
Encoder uses degradation-class supervision; 'without task cues' claim overstated
Encoder pretrained on same degradation configurations later evaluated
Unseen tests compose seen degradations; weak generalization evidence
t-SNE plot is only evidence latent separates unseen classes
No real-world degraded images or no-reference metric evaluation
Numbers in abstract and text inconsistent with tables; duplicated dataset listing
Detection contribution supported only in appendix
3WD is per-pixel gating, not attention; complexity comparison misleading
Table 5 SA/CA replacement drop implausible; implementation details missing
Attention speedup irrelevant to whole-network efficiency claim
Ablation shows 3WD, not latent prior, gives most gain; Base undefined
'w/o LP' unspecified; no non-VAE or plain encoder comparison
No ablation of KL term, regularizer, pretraining data, color split or FFT branch
Ablation numbers differ from Table 1 without explanation
VAE reconstruction of degraded input unconvincing for learning degradation semantics
Global descriptor mu described with spatial dimensions; inconsistent
Degradation map lacks quantitative localization evidence
No tests with spatially varying degradation strengths
Many grammatical errors
No variance or seeds; small gains claimed as wins
Odd citations
Application claims for autonomous systems and healthcare unsupported
Code release not mentioned
Related-work section title mislabels content
